scope: Two retained clients, 64 prebuilt cyclic values, 16 message windows; every encoded sender/value/order checked. Default: global survivors and transient peers in separate rooms. Room mode: one ordinary room, every departing ID and exact FIFO prefix verified at each remaining peer, 16 departures per window paced by shared reader progress so default queue limits remain intact. All peers verify exact normal Close and EOF. Gated event-boundary metrics/CPU/RSS snapshots, no continuous RSS peak claim. Loopback, no TLS; heartbeat and rates disabled. CPU deltas include one management sample at each boundary, at host tick resolution. Profiled cases are diagnostic, not timing samples.
